verdict.rationale: Amplitude documents Experiment APIs for managing flags, experiments, and deployments from CI, scripts, or your own tools. That gives an agent a programmatic path, and a published OpenAPI spec supports it. Elsewhere the docs describe flag ramping, kill-switch toggling, and audience targeting by properties, cohorts, or segments, but they do not explicitly tie these operations to the API. The official MCP server is described only for analytics Q&A, not flag management. missing for 10: explicit API docs for creating, targeting, and toggling flags; MCP server tools for flag operations; independent or hands-on corroboration of agent-driven flag management.
